summary: CAIR Action lists Seema Kanani as a preferred candidate in the Milpitas at-large general election, a directional recommendation treated here as concrete evidence on foreign policy including Gaza. Activist opinion source Samir Laymoun also supported her, though his recommendation may reflect tactical considerations rather than shared policy views. The preferred tier, rather than a full endorsement, is the principal recorded indicator of her stance.
